_help: Copy to sources.json and list the companies and searches you want. Each 'type' is a public job feed: greenhouse (board token from boards.greenhouse.io/<token>), lever (site from jobs.lever.co/<site>), ashby (board from jobs.ashbyhq.com/<board>), smartrecruiters (companyId from jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<companyId>), workable (account from apply.workable.com/<account>), recruitee (site from <site>.recruitee.com), adzuna (needs ADZUNA_APP_ID and ADZUNA_APP_KEY), jsonld (any careers page with schema.org JobPosting markup). onlyLocations keeps jobs whose location matches (plus remote).
